committee.sub: Morning brief · Wednesday 16 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend nearly doubled week on week (A$163.27 vs A$83.92) and clicks rose to 26 from 14, but conversionsLast7 is still 0. Post-restart clicks sit at 29 of the 150 stop-loss threshold, so no case to pull back yet.
Rank lost to budget 30 days is 76.8% against budgetLost30d of 17%, so the constraint is ad rank not spend. Impression share is only 10%. The budget conversation stays closed until that gap flips.

Homepage (22 sessions) and /ai-automation-agency.html (21 sessions) are carrying the traffic, but calculator.usedLast7 is 0 against 46 total sessions, so nobody is reaching the ungated calculator step.

AI Assistant sessions are still 0 for the week and LinkedIn is 0 despite Chris posting there, which points to untagged links rather than no interest. Organic Search ticked up to 7 from 5, still a small signal. Search Console data only runs through 13 Sept, two days behind yesterday.

actions.text: Logo and image assets plus keyword-matched RSA headlines for the serving ad groups are still outstanding.
The homepage form confirm-then-count fix so kontrolTrackLead fires on the Formspree verdict, not before it, remains open.
RSA description D1 still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week; update it to match current site stats.
